title: Delhi Police denies permission for SKM's march to Jantar Mantar on farmers' protest anniversary

ai.summary: Delhi Police denied permission for SKM's planned march to Jantar Mantar on the sixth anniversary of the farmers' protest, citing no application received under Section 163 of the BNSS.

facts.claim: Delhi Police denied permission for SKM's planned march to Jantar Mantar on the sixth anniversary of the farmers' protest
facts.quote: Police said that no application has been received and no permission has been granted for the farmers' protest march.

facts.claim: The march was scheduled for Thursday
facts.quote: The Delhi Police has denied permission to the Samyukta Kisan Morcha’s (SKM) proposed protest march from Kali Bari to Jantar Mantar, scheduled for Thursday.

facts.claim: The march would mark six years since the beginning of the farmers' protest
facts.quote: The farmers’ organisation had planned the march to mark six years since the beginning of the farmers’ protest.

facts.claim: Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, prohibits unauthorised gatherings
facts.quote: Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, is currently in force in the New Delhi district, prohibiting unauthorised gatherings, processions, demonstrations, speeches, sloganeering and dharnas.

facts.claim: DCP (New Delhi) Sachin Sharma stated no application for permission has been received
facts.quote: Information has been received that Samyukta Kisan Morcha and other activists are planning a protest march from Kali Bari to Jantar Mantar on November 26. No application for permission has been received and no permission has been granted for the said march,

ai.background_note: Delhi Police denied permission for SKM's march to Jantar Mantar on the sixth anniversary of the farmers' protest, citing no application received under Section 163 of the BNSS.
